title: Honda Civics and the Evil Valet
summary: A follow-up post on reverse-engineering Honda Civic infotainment systems, focusing on security vulnerabilities discovered in the vehicle's valet/parking modes. This builds on previous automotive security research published in May 2023.
problem_solved: Exposes undocumented behavior and potential security vulnerabilities in Honda Civic infotainment systems that could affect vehicle safety.
why_valuable: Automotive security research is critical as vehicles become increasingly connected, helping manufacturers identify and fix vulnerabilities before they can be exploited by malicious actors.
